```{r}
# Rank each school by free/reduced lunch percentage, on a 0 to 1 scale
df3_new = df3_new %>%
    mutate(frl_percentile_raw = percent_rank(pct_free_reduced))
df3_new
```

```{r}
# Slice that 0 to 1 range into 4 labeled groups
df3_new = df3_new %>%
    mutate(frl_percentile = cut(
        frl_percentile_raw,
        breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
        labels = c("0-25", "25-50", "50-75", "75-100"),
        include.lowest = TRUE
    ))
df3_new
```

```{r}
df3_grouped = df3_new %>%
    group_by(frl_percentile) %>%
    summarize(applied = sum(applied), grade_12 = sum(grade_12))
df3_grouped
```

```{r}
# Remove the NA group
df3_grouped = df3_grouped %>% 
    filter(! is.na(frl_percentile))

df3_grouped
```

```

```

```{r}
# Another way to build the same buckets, this time on the full dataset:
# percent_rank() gives each school's position from 0 to 1, and cut() slices
# that 0-1 range into 4 labeled groups
df3 = df3 %>%
    mutate(
        frl_percentile_raw = percent_rank(pct_free_reduced),
        frl_percentile = cut(
            frl_percentile_raw,
            breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
            labels = c("0-25", "25-50", "50-75", "75-100"),
            include.lowest = TRUE
        )
    )
df3
```

```{r}
# Same group / drop NA / rate steps as before, now all in one pipeline
df3_grouped = df3 %>%
    group_by(frl_percentile) %>%
    summarize(applied = sum(applied), grade_12 = sum(grade_12)) %>%
    filter(! is.na(frl_percentile)) %>%
    mutate(avg_app_rate = applied / grade_12)

df3_grouped
```

```{r}
# The admitted column has missing values, so we have to decide what to do
# with them. Make one column per choice, then compare the results.

# Makes the randomness behave the same every run.
set.seed(131)

df3_imputed = df3 %>%
    mutate(
        admitted_zero = replace_na(admitted, 0),
        admitted_two = replace_na(admitted, 2),
        admitted_random = if_else(
            is.na(admitted),
            sample(0:2, n(), replace = TRUE),
            admitted
        ),
        # Ignoring a row drops its applied count too, not just its admitted count
        applied_kept = if_else(is.na(admitted), 0, applied)
    )
```

```{r}
# One summarize gives us the admission rate under all four choices
rate_by_decile = df3_imputed %>%
    group_by(frl_percentile) %>%
    summarize(
        applied = sum(applied),
        applied_kept = sum(applied_kept),
        admitted_zero = sum(admitted_zero),
        admitted_two = sum(admitted_two),
        admitted_random = sum(admitted_random)
    ) %>%
    filter(! is.na(frl_percentile)) %>%
    mutate(
        rate_ignore = admitted_zero / applied_kept,
        rate_zero = admitted_zero / applied,
        rate_two = admitted_two / applied,
        rate_random = admitted_random / applied
    )

rate_by_decile
```

```{r}
# Method 1: Ignore rows where admitted is NA
ggplot(rate_by_decile, aes(x = frl_percentile, y = rate_ignore, group = 1)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "Ignore admitted=NA", y='admission_rate')
```

```{r}
# Method 2: Replace NA admitted with 0
ggplot(rate_by_decile, aes(x = frl_percentile, y = rate_zero, group = 1)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "Replace admitted=NA with 0", y='admission_rate')
```

```{r}
# Method 3: Replace NA admitted with 2
ggplot(rate_by_decile, aes(x = frl_percentile, y = rate_two, group = 1)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "Replace admitted=NA with 2", y='admission_rate')
```

```{r}
# Method 4: Replace NA admitted with a random whole number from 0 to 2
ggplot(rate_by_decile, aes(x = frl_percentile, y = rate_random, group = 1)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "Replace admitted=NA with random 0 to 2", y='admission_rate')
```

```{r}
# All four choices on one pair of axes
ggplot(rate_by_decile, aes(x = frl_percentile, group = 1)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rate_ignore, color = "ignore NA")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rate_zero, color = "NA becomes 0")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rate_two, color = "NA becomes 2")) +
    geom_line(aes(y = rate_random, color = "NA becomes random 0 to 2")) +
    labs(y = "admission_rate", color = "method")
```

```{r}
# Same random imputation, now for attendance rates
# But also ignore rows with admitted=NA
set.seed(7342)

attendance_by_decile = df3 %>%
    filter(!is.na(admitted), !is.na(frl_percentile)) %>%
    mutate(attended_random = if_else(
        is.na(attended),
        sample(0:2, n(), replace = TRUE),
        attended
    )) %>%
    group_by(frl_percentile) %>%
    summarize(attended_random = sum(attended_random), admitted = sum(admitted)) %>%
    mutate(attendance_rate = attended_random / admitted)

ggplot(attendance_by_decile, aes(x = frl_percentile, y = attendance_rate, group = 1)) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = "Replace attended=NA with random 0 to 2")
```

```{r}
# Same percentile bucketing, but for distance to UC Berkeley
df3 = df3 %>%
    mutate(dist_percentile_raw = percent_rank(dist_to_ucb_miles)) %>%
    mutate(dist_percentile = cut(
        dist_percentile_raw,
        breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
        labels = c("0-25", "25-50", "50-75", "75-100"),
        include.lowest = TRUE
    ))
df3
```

```{r}
# Group by two variables at once
df3_grouped = df3 %>%
    group_by(frl_percentile, dist_percentile) %>%
    summarize(applied = sum(applied), grade_12 = sum(grade_12), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(app_rate = applied / grade_12) %>% 
    filter(! is.na(frl_percentile))

df3_grouped
```


```{r}
# One line per distance bucket
ggplot(df3_grouped, aes(
    x = frl_percentile,
    y = app_rate,
    color = dist_percentile,
    group = dist_percentile
)) +
    geom_line()
```

```{r}
# Build filtered dataset: bigger, non-charter schools only
# df3 already has app_rate, so we only need the distance buckets here
df3_scatter = df3 %>%
    filter(tot_enrolled >= 100, is_charter == "N") %>%
    drop_na(pct_free_reduced, app_rate) %>%
    mutate(dist_to_ucb_bucket = ntile(dist_to_ucb_miles, 5)) %>%
    mutate(dist_to_ucb_bucket = factor(
        dist_to_ucb_bucket,
        labels = c(
            "1st (0-20%)", "2nd (20-40%)", "3rd (40-60%)",
            "4th (60-80%)", "5th (80-100%)"
        )
    ))

nrow(df3_scatter)
count(df3_scatter, dist_to_ucb_bucket)
```

```{r}
# One scatter plot panel per distance quintile
ggplot(df3_scatter, aes(x = pct_free_reduced, y = app_rate, size = grade_12)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~dist_to_ucb_bucket, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = "free_reduced_percentage", y = "app_rate", size = "grade_12")
```
